requirement_match.summary: Approved two-surface presentation implemented; posts beta and real article cards retained; scope matches task-start diff.

security.summary: Owner-filtered ticket read, configured/user submit guard, validation limits and payload remain intact. No backend/auth/dependency changes, new telemetry or production mutation.

code_quality.summary: Historical review checkpoint: identified in-scope findings required correction before handoff. Recorded retrospectively after executing fixes and verification; this is not a pre-fix source snapshot.

failure_paths.summary: Fixture covers loading, empty, errors, stale and partial posts; pending and failed support submission, long tickets, topic deep links and disabled signed-out submission. 12 existing cache/public HTML tests pass.

error_handling.summary: Existing retry/role alert preserved. Rejected fixture submit preserves input; successful mock resets fields/topic; no fabricated durable success.

production_readiness.summary: Deployment impact reviewed: no migrations, config, auth or backend changes. Local Vite build passes. Live service acceptance NOT TESTED; full application production readiness NOT_READY. Legacy/manual review is not authenticated release approval.

trade_offs.summary: Preserve established catalog/chrome/chat; no fake published content. Existing build chunk warnings retained. Optional indexes DEGRADED; native source used. Actual browser zoom, cross-browser and full screen-reader certification not run.

findings.summary: Data request examples referred to buying items and used internal ticket terminology.
Inherited two-column card grid at 390px makes populated posts too dense.

residual_risks: Live auth, ticket persistence, provider and production acceptance not tested by this UI task.
Shared checkout has unrelated WIP and can change after source freeze.
Optional intelligence indexes stale; approval validator hardcodes READY contrary to degraded-fallback policy; no governance file altered.
limitations: Manual self-review under canonical skill; no independent authenticated release approval.
640px reflow proxy verified; real 200 percent browser zoom, full screen reader and cross-browser audit not certified.
Fixture exercises real components with mock service/cache; it does not prove backend acceptance.
